items.q: Which plant tissue is the main site of photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Watter plantweefsel is die hoofplek van fotosintese?
items.explain: Parenchyma cells in the leaf mesophyll contain many chloroplasts.
items.explainAf: Parenchiemselle in die blaar se mesofiel bevat baie chloroplaste.

items.q: Which plant tissue gives strength to mature stems and is made of dead cells with lignified walls?
items.qAf: Watter plantweefsel gee sterkte aan volwasse stingels en bestaan uit dooie selle met verhoute wande?
items.explain: Sclerenchyma has thick, lignified walls and gives support to mature plant parts.
items.explainAf: Sklerenchiem het dik, verhoute wande en gee ondersteuning aan volwasse plantdele.

items.q: The epidermis of a leaf is covered by a waxy layer. What is this layer called?
items.qAf: Die epidermis van ’n blaar word deur ’n waslaag bedek. Wat word hierdie laag genoem?
items.explain: The waxy cuticle reduces water loss from the leaf surface.
items.explainAf: Die waskutikula verminder waterverlies van die blaaroppervlak.

items.q: Which animal tissue contracts to produce movement?
items.qAf: Watter dierweefsel trek saam om beweging te veroorsaak?
items.explain: Muscle tissue contracts and causes movement.
items.explainAf: Spierweefsel trek saam en veroorsaak beweging.

items.q: Which tissue connects, supports and stores fat in the body?
items.qAf: Watter weefsel verbind, ondersteun en stoor vet in die liggaam?
items.explain: Connective tissue binds structures together, gives support and stores fat.
items.explainAf: Bindweefsel verbind strukture, gee ondersteuning en stoor vet.

items.q: Which tissue covers body surfaces and lines the gut?
items.qAf: Watter weefsel bedek liggaamsoppervlaktes en beklee die spysverteringskanaal?
items.explain: Epithelial tissue forms protective and absorbing layers on surfaces.
items.explainAf: Epiteelweefsel vorm beskermende en absorberende lae op oppervlaktes.
